_doc: Canonical course-status set for the generator. The same 6 members live in webapp src/lib/current-bearing.ts (COURSE_STATUSES) and the plugin schema (data/schemas/current-bearing.json current_course.status.enum). generate-contracts.mjs PARITY-asserts BOTH against this list (same members, same order) and generates the plugin status-legend fragment from it — add/rename a status here + both copies in the same change, or CI goes red. (The webapp's existing course-status-parity.test.ts remains as a redundant guard.)

statuses.desc: Act on the current course — no load-bearing reason to change.
Do not execute yet — a repair or human check must come first.
A genuine load-bearing decision with a real alternative pole.
Stay put — every named axis is already satisfied; no fork to work.
The agent team should revise before boss/user signoff.
Blocked on external/human evidence before the course can be set.
